newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore share index fall to new 30-month low.
newsitem.headline: Singapore share index fall to new 30-month low.

text.p: Singapore shares as measured by the key Straits Times Industrial Index (STI) fell to a new 30-month low of 1,960.87, down 1.11 percent, in mid-afternoon trade on Thursday.
Dealers said funds were selling index-linked blue chips, especially banks and property counters.
"There is no panic selling but the selling has been fairly aggressive," said a dealer with a Singapore brokerage.
"There is also some buying interest when blue chips, like Keppel Corp, came off to lower levels," said another broker.
Singapore Telecom led the actives with more than 5.61 million traded. It was down 14 cents to S$2.56.
Dealers said sentiment was weighed by weak regional currencies and the volatility on Wall Street.
At 0759 GMT, the STI index was down 21.78 to 1,961.19.
